purpose: Inspect exact GW001 anomalous playoff and orphan Match Report fixtures
sql: SELECT 'PLAYOFF_RESULT_MISMATCH' anomaly,r.sm_fixture_id,r.competition_key result_key,m.competition_key report_key,r.match_date,r.home_name,r.away_name,r.home_score,r.away_score,r.sm_action,r.sm_division,r.competition_stage FROM `GW001_IMC Results` r JOIN `GW001_IMC Match Report` m ON m.sm_fixture_id=r.sm_fixture_id WHERE r.competition_key='GW001|DOMESTIC|playoff' AND m.competition_key<>r.competition_key UNION ALL SELECT 'ORPHAN_REPORT' anomaly,m.sm_fixture_id,NULL result_key,m.competition_key report_key,m.match_date,m.home_name,m.away_name,m.home_score,m.away_score,m.sm_action,m.sm_division,m.competition_stage FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` m LEFT JOIN `GW001_IMC Results` r ON r.sm_fixture_id=m.sm_fixture_id WHERE r.sm_fixture_id IS NULL AND m.competition_key IN ('GW001|DOMESTIC|playoff|4','GW001|INTERNATIONAL|smfacup','GW001|INTERNATIONAL|smfashield') ORDER BY anomaly,report_key,sm_fixture_id
